relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: InflateRankDims decompresses attacker-controlled compressed data from the MAT file into the stack buffer uncomp_buf. The decompressed tag at uncomp_buf[0..1] holds the dimensions byte count, which is the vulnerability-relevant tainted value. If the zlib stream ends or errors during tag inflation, InflateRankDims returns early without allocating a heap dims buffer, leaving *dims NULL.

The dimension rank is derived from the attacker-controlled decompressed byte count without validating that it fits within the stack buffer capacity when dims aliases uncomp_buf+2. The fix adds: if (0 == do_clean && matvar->rank > 13) { error; break; }.

The copy loop reads dims[j] where dims aliases uncomp_buf+2. When j+2 >= 16 (rank > 13), dims[j] reads past the 16-element uncomp_buf stack array boundary, causing a 4-byte stack-buffer-overflow READ.

edges.description: matvar->rank is derived from nbytes / 4, where nbytes = uncomp_buf[1] is the attacker-controlled decompressed byte count. No bounds validation intervenes.
edges.evidence: nbytes_div4 == rank in all traces (694 == 694 for original, 2 == 2 for perturbation)
